{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# The question asks for the mean biomarker_final value across all patients
# But each patient has two sample_seq values (1 and 2) for the same biomarker
# We need to decide: which sample_seq to use?

# The data dictionary says:
# - sample_seq 1: baseline (week 0)
# - sample_seq 2: final (week 12)

# We are asked for week-12 biomarker value, which is sample_seq 2
# But only 48 patients have sample_seq 2
# The rest have only sample_seq 1

# So we must filter to sample_seq == 2
# Then compute the mean of biomarker_final

# Filter to only week-12 (sample_seq == 2)
week12_data = df[df['sample_seq'] == 2]

# Compute mean biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = week12_data['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (week 12) for patients with sample_seq 2: {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
